Purchase options and add-ons

Sign in to continue
  • The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order Elite Trainer Box includes 9 Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order booster packs, 1 full-art foil promo card featuring Tyrunt, and 65 card sleeves.
  • This also comes with 40 Pokémon TCG Energy cards, a player’s guide to the Mega Evolution—Perfect Order expansion, and 6 damage-counter dice.
  • You will also receive a competition-legal coin-flip die, a plastic coin, and a collector’s box to hold everything, with 6 dividers to keep it organized.
  • And you will also find a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live.

Product Description

Secret Powers Awaken! The pulse of the city beats in sync with the Pokémon and people who call it home—and preserving the order of it all is Mega Zygarde ex, the Legendary Pokémon who embodies strength in numbers. With threatening forces held at bay, peaceful days are ahead for the city’s residents, including Pokémon like Mega Clefable ex, Mega Starmie ex, and Meowth ex, in the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order expansion.

WARNING:

CHOKING HAZARD -- Small parts. Not for children under 3 yrs.

What's in the box

  • Booster Pack (9); Full Art Foil Card; Card Sleeve (65)
  • Energy Card (40); Player's Guide; Die (7)
  • Coin; Collector's Box; Code Card

    Important information

    Directions

    1. Open the Elite Trainer Box. 2. Remove the 9 Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order booster packs. 3. Remove the full-art foil promo card featuring Tyrunt. 4. Remove the 65 card sleeves. 5. Remove the 40 Pokémon TCG Energy cards. 6. Remove the player’s guide to the Mega Evolution—Perfect Order expansion. 7. Remove the 6 damage-counter dice. 8. Remove the competition-legal coin-flip die. 9. Remove the plastic coin. 10. Remove the collector’s box and the 6 dividers. 11. Use the booster packs to build decks and play the Pokémon Trading Card Game, following the rules outlined in the player’s guide. 12. Use the code card to access Pokémon Trading Card Game Live.

    • Lynn C.
      1 out of 5 stars
      Damaged/Dented Packaging, Very Suspect, High Chance Product Was Resealed
      Reviewed in the United States on May 20, 2026
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Item arrived tampered with / resealed. Keep an eye on who your ETB is shipping from, most third party retailers on Amazon can NOT be trusted. Box and packaging were dented and in mid to acceptable quality. Due to damage the outer art/sleeve were not worth keeping. Packs split open unnaturally easily at the top seam. Cards inside the boosters were facing the wrong direction in some, and placed in the wrong order in a couple others. I've never even seen cards use reverse/non-art special energies as the rare card in the pack before. Two of my packs featured basic "Growing Energy" and "Telepathic Energy" cards.

      I've had horrible luck before, and traditionally it's not great. But I've never in my life seen such horrible pulls, nothing in the ETB was above 5 dollars. Most cards averaged 10-15 cents including the "rare" pulls. Considering the state of the package, the ease of opening and the strange way the contents were in a few of the packs I think it's safe to say this is a modified/scam product. At least from the seller Amazon sold me mine from.

      Amazon treats cards as a service and not a product, so you can't even reach out to them for support. Instead they demand you contact Pokemon, who needless to say will not refund/warranty products sold by amazon sellers.

    About this Item

    • The Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order Elite Trainer Box includes 9 Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order booster packs, 1 full-art foil promo card featuring Tyrunt, and 65 card sleeves.
    • This also comes with 40 Pokémon TCG Energy cards, a player’s guide to the Mega Evolution—Perfect Order expansion, and 6 damage-counter dice.
    • You will also receive a competition-legal coin-flip die, a plastic coin, and a collector’s box to hold everything, with 6 dividers to keep it organized.
    • And you will also find a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live.

    Product Description

    Secret Powers Awaken! The pulse of the city beats in sync with the Pokémon and people who call it home—and preserving the order of it all is Mega Zygarde ex, the Legendary Pokémon who embodies strength in numbers. With threatening forces held at bay, peaceful days are ahead for the city’s residents, including Pokémon like Mega Clefable ex, Mega Starmie ex, and Meowth ex, in the Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order expansion.

    Important Information

    Directions

    1. Open the Elite Trainer Box. 2. Remove the 9 Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Perfect Order booster packs. 3. Remove the full-art foil promo card featuring Tyrunt. 4. Remove the 65 card sleeves. 5. Remove the 40 Pokémon TCG Energy cards. 6. Remove the player’s guide to the Mega Evolution—Perfect Order expansion. 7. Remove the 6 damage-counter dice. 8. Remove the competition-legal coin-flip die. 9. Remove the plastic coin. 10. Remove the collector’s box and the 6 dividers. 11. Use the booster packs to build decks and play the Pokémon Trading Card Game, following the rules outlined in the player’s guide. 12. Use the code card to access Pokémon Trading Card Game Live.
